title: Sentinel post-calibration full pipeline run on Base Azul multiproof
summary: Post-calibration end-to-end: think 40-to-9 (78pct cut), surface-tag selected 7 specialists from 11, dispatcher fired 8 hyp-to-specialist matches (4 spec_divergence, 3 parameter_validation, 1 signature_replay). All 8 walked: 4 spec NatSpec claims match code (onlyOwner/onlyOwnerOrRevoker), 1 TEEProverRegistry init duplicate-element idempotent (true negative same shape as ASTROSSC-290 but not exploitable), 1 known TEE setGameType asymmetry OOS. ZERO new fileable findings, confirms exhaustion.
key_lesson: Post-calibration pipeline runs in seconds and surfaces only high-precision hypotheses. The dispatcher is the gate that turns 9 hypotheses into 8 specialist-relevant targets, each with a clear bug-class-shaped reason for inspection. Without it, 5 LLM specialists would have surveyed the entire surface for nothing.
